name: Levoit Vital 200S
summary: A slim, rectangular purifier rated at 250 cfm, enough for most studios. Three independent hands-on reviews agree it cleans fast, and HouseFresh's measured CADR matches Levoit's rating. Its bonded filter has to be replaced as one piece, and the carbon layer can run out before the year is up.
idealFor: Most studios up to about 400 sq ft
Buyers who want an app and auto mode at a mid-range price
pros: HouseFresh measured 249 cfm (PM1) at top speed, in line with the 250 cfm rating
Cleared HouseFresh's 728 cu ft test room in 23 minutes
App with auto mode and filter tracking; no ionizer
cons: Bonded filter: the carbon often runs out within about 6 months (HouseFresh)
Less cleaning at quiet speeds than the Coway (128 vs 151 cfm under 45 dBA)
The air quality sensor needs cleaning about every two months

trust.summary: Three independent hands-on reviews agree it cleans quickly, and HouseFresh's measured CADR matches the rating. Levoit publishes measurable specs, a 2-year warranty with a clear claim process and a US address. Its CARB certification is on the state's public list and there are no CPSC recalls for the brand; it loses safety points only because materials aren't declared.

sources.title: HouseFresh: Levoit Vital 200S review
sources.note: Danny Ashton, bought with own money and used at home for over two years. PM1 CADR 249 cfm at top, 128 cfm under 45 dBA; test room cleared in 23 min; 38.3–57.7 dBA at 3 ft; bonded filter, carbon often spent within 6 months
